about.title: About
about.subtitle: A journey of presence, deep listening, and inner transformation.
about.photoAlt: Portrait of meditation teacher Fabrizio Leyzon
about.paragraph1: My interest in self-knowledge, awareness, and inner transformation comes from the direct experience of observing life, its changes, and the challenges we all face.
about.paragraph2: I accompany people who wish to understand themselves more deeply, develop a more conscious relationship with themselves, and find ways to inhabit their emotions, their processes, and their own story from a broader, more compassionate perspective.
about.paragraph3: I believe in the importance of presence, deep listening, and genuine connection as tools for well-being and personal growth.
about.presenceDesc: Cultivating the ability to be here and now with openness and attention.
about.listenDesc: Creating safe spaces where every experience can be witnessed and understood.
about.transformationDesc: Recognizing patterns, developing awareness, and opening new possibilities for growth.

reprogramming.title: Pattern Release
reprogramming.subtitle: Rewriting the Inner Story
reprogramming.desc: A guided process to identify and transform beliefs and patterns that no longer serve you, creating new neural pathways toward well-being.
reprogramming.step1Desc: Make visible the patterns that repeat in how you think, feel, relate, and make decisions.
reprogramming.step2Desc: Recognize where certain beliefs, inner stories, and ways of responding to life come from.
reprogramming.step3Desc: Open the possibility of building a freer, more conscious, and compassionate relationship with yourself.
reprogramming.step4Desc: Bring that new understanding into daily life through small conscious decisions.
reprogramming.intro:
Much of what we experience isn't truly a conscious choice, but the repetition of stories we learned to live as if they were truth.

Beliefs about who you are.

About how you should behave.

About what you can or cannot receive.

About how life is supposed to be.

Over time, these ideas solidify into patterns.

And patterns become identity.
reprogramming.description:
This process is a space of conscious dialogue where we explore your personal history to observe the patterns that repeat in your emotional, mental, and relational life.

Through conversation and writing, what normally operates automatically becomes visible.

It's not about fixing you or turning you into someone different.

It's about looking clearly at the stories you've learned to inhabit to reclaim the possibility of choosing from a more conscious place.
reprogramming.note: This is an educational and personal growth companionship service. It does not substitute psychological therapy or professional medical attention. If you're going through a moment of intense emotional crisis, we recommend seeking specialized professional support.

resources.title: Resources
resources.subtitle: A space to share reflections, meditations, and tools that accompany your journey of self-knowledge, presence, and transformation.
resources.featuredText1: Life seems long when we think about it, but brief when we observe it with attention.
resources.featuredText2: So often we live as if there were always more time: more time to be grateful, to listen, to say what we feel, or to fully inhabit the present moment.
resources.featuredText3: Remembering that our experience is finite doesn't have to create fear. It can become an invitation to live with greater awareness, presence, and depth.
resources.featuredText4: Perhaps the question isn't how much time we have, but how we choose to inhabit the time we've been given.

hero.title: PATTERN MODIFICATION
hero.lead: A deep exploration of what you learned to repeat

intro.paragraph1: There are ways of thinking, feeling, and acting that seem to belong to our personality, but that are often learned responses.
intro.ladderLead: Patterns that were built throughout our history and that, in the face of certain circumstances, reappear:
intro.ladderLine5: and also in the ways we sabotage ourselves without realizing it.
intro.paragraph2: This program proposes observing those patterns from their origin and discovering what keeps them running.
intro.paragraph3: It is not about receiving advice on what to do.
intro.paragraph4: It is about discovering for ourselves what needs to be seen, understood, and modified.

work.title: THE WORK IS YOURS
work.paragraph1: The process begins with your own history.
work.paragraph2: Through written communication, we will explore experiences, events, decisions, relationships, emotions, and recurring situations to identify the patterns behind certain attitudes, behaviors, and ways of relating to reality.
work.paragraph3: The facilitator does not interpret your life for you, nor tells you who you are.
work.paragraph4: Their role is to ask the necessary questions.
work.questionsLine2: Questions that allow going beyond the usual explanation.
work.questionsLine3: Surgical questions to find the exact point where something can be modified.
work.closing: Discovery and transformation belong entirely to the client.

technology.title: A TECHNOLOGY OF CONSCIOUSNESS
technology.paragraph1: The program uses a system of exploration that contemplates each stage of the process of modifying or rewriting reality and inner experience.
technology.paragraph2: We start from a simple idea:
technology.paragraph3: The way we experience our reality is not separate from our history, our interpretations, our emotions, our bodily responses, and our habitual ways of acting.
technology.paragraph4: By making the structure of a pattern conscious, we can begin to relate to it in a different way.
technology.paragraph5: Within this system, inner experience is contemplated as a technology of consciousness: a map that relates different levels of manifestation to specific zones and functions of the human and subtle anatomy.

map.title: MANIFESTATION MAP

medios.name: Means
medios.description: The way we relate to the means available to move, act, and accomplish.

carisma.name: Charisma
carisma.description: The capacity to relate, influence, and express our presence in the encounter with others.

capacidad.name: Capacity
capacidad.description: The inner resources to hold, execute, and carry something toward experience.

orientacion.name: Orientation
orientacion.description: The direction from which we position ourselves and move in life.

eliminacion.name: Elimination
eliminacion.description: The capacity to release, complete cycles, and let go of what we no longer need.

asimilacion.name: Assimilation
asimilacion.description: The way we receive, process, and integrate our experiences.

impulso.name: Impulse
impulso.description: The force that moves us toward action, desire, and expression.

necesidades.name: Needs
necesidades.description: The capacity to recognize, express, and receive what we need.

posibilidades.name: Possibilities
posibilidades.description: The perception of the possible and our relationship with what does not yet exist in our experience.

forma.name: Form
forma.description: The way we perceive, focus, and give shape to our reality.

sustancia.name: Substance
sustancia.description: What we receive, listen to, and allow to become part of our experience.

map.disclaimer: This map does not intend to replace a medical or anatomical explanation. It is part of the conceptual and contemplative language used within the process.

historia.name: YOUR HISTORY
historia.paragraph1: We begin with what you have lived.
historia.paragraph2: Significant experiences, relationships, conflicts, decisions, repetitions, and situations that keep producing certain responses.

patron.name: THE PATTERN
patron.paragraph1: We look for what repeats itself.
patron.question4: What do you try to avoid?
patron.detail: what structure is sustaining that behavior?

pregunta.name: THE QUESTION
pregunta.paragraph1: The facilitator intervenes mainly through questions.
pregunta.paragraph2: Not to give you an answer, but to help you reach the place where the answer can be discovered by you.

modificacion.name: THE MODIFICATION
modificacion.paragraph1: Once the pattern is recognized, the process of modification or rewriting begins.
modificacion.paragraph2: Understanding something intellectually is not enough.
modificacion.paragraph3: Modification involves observing how that structure appears in your experience and beginning to generate a different relationship with it.

integracion.name: THE INTEGRATION
integracion.paragraph1: The final goal is not to accumulate answers.
integracion.paragraph2: It is to develop a greater capacity to recognize your own patterns while they are happening and to consciously participate in the way you respond.

membership.title: A SUBSCRIPTION, NOT A FIXED-TIME PROGRAM
membership.paragraph1: Pattern modification does not necessarily have an eight-week calendar.
membership.paragraph2: Each person arrives with a different history and finds different points of work.
membership.paragraph3: That is why the proposal works as a monthly membership.
membership.benefit7: Continuous follow-up while the membership remains active.
membership.paragraph4: You do not need to write every day.
membership.paragraph5: You can write when something happens, when a question arises, when you recognize a pattern, or when you need to explore something that is happening in your experience.
membership.paragraph6: The process moves at the pace of what you are living.

statement.title: I DO NOT COME TO TELL YOU WHAT TO DO
statement.paragraph1: This work starts from a fundamental premise:
statement.premise: No one can modify your reality for you.
statement.ladderLine2: I can point out a contradiction.
statement.ladderLine3: I can take you to a place you may not have observed.
statement.ladderLine4: But the discovery, the decision, and the modification are yours.
statement.paragraph2: Because the purpose is not for you to depend on someone who interprets your life.
statement.paragraph3: It is for you to learn to observe it with enough clarity to begin to participate consciously in it.

finale.line4: Modify what you no longer want to repeat.
finale.cta: I want to begin the process
